summary.note: A generic agent with no knowledge of this skill produces solid, evidence-grounded reasoning but organizes it around its own ad hoc framework (severity/business-impact-first ordering, a two-axis complexity/risk rating with no separate benefit axis) rather than the skill's specific complexity/risk/benefit rubric, named bucket taxonomy, recommendation_id scheme, or quick-wins-first sequencing convention. All 6 failures trace directly to those skill-specific conventions being entirely absent from the baseline's vocabulary and structure, not to any factual or evidentiary error in its analysis.
